mapper.sql: select id, order_id, order_type,source_platform, platform_order_code, shipping_method, order_time, delivery_time, discount_amount, remark, is_inbound_delivery, is_collected_shipping_cost, shipping_cost, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted from sal_yt_order_sub where is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: update sal_yt_order_sub set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id}

update sal_yt_order_sub set is_deleted = 1 where id in
#{id}
update sal_yt_order_sub set is_deleted = 1 where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: select min(status) as minStatus from sal_yt_order_sub_item where order_sub_id = #{orderSubId} and is_deleted = 0
select sum(price * number) as totalAmount from sal_yt_order_sub_item where order_sub_id = #{orderSubId} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT base.*, -- 利润：考虑币种，美元订单需要换算 CASE WHEN base.currency = '1' THEN (base.totalOrderPrice - base.totalOrderCost ) ELSE base.totalOrderPrice - base.totalOrderCost END AS profit, -- 利润率：考虑币种，美元订单需要换算 CASE WHEN base.totalOrderPrice > 0 THEN CASE WHEN base.currency = '1' THEN ((base.totalOrderPrice - base.totalOrderCost ) / (base.totalOrderPrice )) * 100 ELSE ((base.totalOrderPrice - base.totalOrderCost) / base.totalOrderPrice) * 100 END ELSE 0 END as profitRate FROM ( SELECT so.id, so.code , so.create_time AS create_time, so.receive_status as receiveStatus, so.currency, so.exchange_rate, -- 运费：当已收取运费时取主表shipping_cost，未收取时从子订单的receive_shipping字段累加 CASE WHEN so.is_collected_shipping_cost = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(sos.receive_shipping), 0) ELSE so.shipping_cost END AS totalShippingPrice, -- 优惠金额（从主表） so.discount_amount as discountAmount, so.is_collected_shipping_cost, -- 商品收入：美元订单需要乘以汇率换算为人民币 CASE WHEN so.currency = '1' THEN SUM(sosi.price * sosi.number) * so.exchange_rate ELSE SUM(sosi.price * sosi.number) END AS totalItemPrice, -- 订单总收入 = 商品收入 + 运费 - 优惠金额：美元订单需要乘以汇率换算为人民币 -- 当未收取运费时，运费从子订单的receive_shipping字段累加 CASE WHEN so.currency = '1' THEN (SUM(sosi.price * sosi.number) + CASE WHEN so.is_collected_shipping_cost = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(sos.receive_shipping), 0) ELSE so.shipping_cost END - so.discount_amount) * so.exchange_rate ELSE SUM(sosi.price * sosi.number) + CASE WHEN so.is_collected_shipping_cost = 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(sos.receive_shipping), 0) ELSE so.shipping_cost END - so.discount_amount END AS totalOrderPrice, SUM(sosi.supplier_price * sosi.number) AS totalItemCost, -- 运费成本：从子订单的payment_shipping字段累加 COALESCE(SUM(sos.payment_shipping), 0) AS totalShippingCost, SUM(sosi.supplier_price * sosi.number) + COALESCE(SUM(sos.payment_shipping), 0) AS totalOrderCost, so.follow_employee_id, so.sale_employee_id, so.follow_ratio, so.sale_ratio, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = so.follow_employee_id) as follow_employee_name, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = so.sale_employee_id) as sale_employee_name, c.name as customerName, so.customer_address FROM sal_yt_order so LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub sos ON so.id = sos.order_id AND sos.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub_item sosi ON sos.id = sosi.order_sub_id AND sosi.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE so.is_deleted = 0
-- AND so.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM sal_yt_order_sub WHERE id = {subId}) AND so.id = #{orderId}
AND so.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subCode}, '%')
GROUP BY so.id ) AS base

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delivery_proportion * total_delivery_receive), 0) AS receiveShipping FROM ( SELECT delivery_id, (number / total_delivery_number) AS delivery_proportion FROM ( SELECT sydi.order_sub_id, sydi.delivery_id, sydi.number, (SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = sydi.delivery_id AND is_deleted = 0) AS total_delivery_number FROM sto_yt_delivery_item sydi WHERE sydi.order_sub_id = #{orderSubId} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0 ) AS order_sub_delivery WHERE total_delivery_number > 0 ) AS delivery_proportions LEFT JOIN ( SELECT delivery_id, SUM(amount) AS total_delivery_receive FROM sto_yt_delivery_receive WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY delivery_id ) AS delivery_receives ON delivery_proportions.delivery_id = delivery_receives.delivery_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delivery_proportion * delivery_amount), 0) AS paymentShipping FROM ( SELECT delivery_id, (number / total_delivery_number) AS delivery_proportion, (SELECT delivery_amount FROM sto_yt_delivery WHERE id = order_sub_delivery.delivery_id AND is_deleted = 0) AS delivery_amount FROM ( SELECT sydi.order_sub_id, sydi.delivery_id, sydi.number, (SELECT SUM(number) FROM sto_yt_delivery_item WHERE delivery_id = sydi.delivery_id AND is_deleted = 0) AS total_delivery_number FROM sto_yt_delivery_item sydi WHERE sydi.order_sub_id = #{orderSubId} AND sydi.is_deleted = 0 ) AS order_sub_delivery WHERE total_delivery_number > 0 ) AS delivery_proportions

SELECT (select code from pro_yt_product where id = sosi.product_id) as productCode, SUM(sosi.number) AS number, -- sosi.price as unitPrice, -- sosi.supplier_price as unitCost, MAX(sosi.price) as unitPrice, MAX(so.currency) as currency, MAX(so.exchange_rate) as exchangeRate, MAX(sosi.supplier_price) as unitCost, SUM(sosi.price * sosi.number) AS totalPrice, SUM(sosi.supplier_price * sosi.number) AS totalCost, SUM((sosi.price - sosi.supplier_price) * sosi.number) AS totalProfit, -- ((SUM((sosi.price - sosi.supplier_price) * sosi.number) / NULLIF(SUM(sosi.price * sosi.number), 0)) * 100) AS profitRate, ((SUM(CASE WHEN so.currency = '1' THEN sosi.price * sosi.number * so.exchange_rate ELSE sosi.price * sosi.number END) - SUM(sosi.supplier_price * sosi.number)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN so.currency = '1' THEN sosi.price * sosi.number * so.exchange_rate ELSE sosi.price * sosi.number END), 0) * 100) AS profitRate, sosi.specification_id FROM sal_yt_order_sub_item sosi LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub sos ON sosi.order_sub_id = sos.id AND sos.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order so ON sos.order_id = so.id AND so.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sosi.is_deleted = 0 and sosi.specification_id is not null
AND so.id = #{orderId}
AND sosi.product_id in( select id from pro_yt_product where code like concat('%',#{productCode},'%'))
AND sosi.specification_id in( select product_specification_id from pro_yt_product_specification_item where category_specification_item_id in (select id from pro_yt_category_specification_item where value like concat('%',#{specificationName},'%')) and is_deleted=0 )
AND sos.sub_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subCode}, '%')
group by sosi.specification_id, sosi.product_id ORDER BY sosi.product_id
select min(status) as minStatus from sal_yt_order_sub_item where order_sub_id = #{orderSubId} and is_deleted = 0 and specification_id is not null
select b.* from sal_yt_order_sub a right join sal_yt_order_sub_item b on a.id=b.order_sub_id where a.order_id=#{orderId} and b.is_deleted=0 and a.is_deleted=0
